description: Read the retest history for a finding by human identifier such as ODI-12 or internal findingId. Distinguishes no history, queued or running, completed, skipped, failed, and gated/unavailable results. This tool never triggers a retest or spends credits.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: get_finding_retests
title: Get finding retest history
